sentences.text: 1 Respondents from taking any coercive action.
It seems that despite the assurance given by the Counsels, the Respondents have taken further coercive action which is a violation of the orders of this Court.
4. Dr. Manisha Narayan is directed to remain present in Court at 2:30 PM today.
Inspector Bhupender Kumar, who is present is Court is also directed to remain present at 2:30 PM today.
5. In the meantime, no further action be taken by the Respondents in the matter.
SUBRAMONIUM PRASAD, J DECEMBER 6, 2023 hsk At 03:30 PM
6. The Writ Petition was mentioned on 05.12.2023 before the Hon'ble the Acting Chief Justice and the case was listed for urgent hearing before this Court at 02:00 PM.

7. This Court, in the presence of the learned Counsels for Union of India and the Delhi Police had given an oral direction to the Respondents not to take any precipitate action against the Petitioner and an assurance was given This is a digitally signed order.
The authenticity of the order can be re-verified from Delhi High Court Order Portal by scanning the QR code shown above.
The Order is downloaded from the DHC Server on 07/12/2023 at 04:29:09 by the learned Counsels for the Respondents to this Court that no coercive steps will be taken.
8. In gross violation of the directions of this Court, Respondent No.1 has destroyed the goods lying in the godown of the Petitioner.

9. When the matter came up for hearing in the first round, Inspector Bhupender Kumar made a statement that Dr. Manisha Narayan, an officer of FSSAI who had directed for the destruction of the items in the factory concerned, was informed about the matter and the directions passed by this Court.
In the second round he states that he had only informed Dr. Manisha Narayan that the matter is being listed for today.
The Officer ought to have awaited the Orders of this Court especially when the matter was adjourned only for a day.

10. Let an affidavit be filed by Inspector Bhupender Kumar as to what was the information passed by him to Dr. Manisha Narayan.
11. Let an affidavit be also filed by Dr. Manisha Narayan that she was not informed about the directions of the Court.

12. Let the affidavits be filed during the course of the day.
13. List on 07.12.2023 at 02:00 PM.
SUBRAMONIUM PRASAD, J DECEMBER 6, 2023 Rahul
